```{r }
#| label: fig-sexorientation-mixing-matrix
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: Spatial mixing matrix by sexual orientation. The spatial mixing ratio measures the extent to which members of one sexual orientation subgroup share community districts with members of another subgroup relative to chance. Values greater than 1 indicate more mixing than expected, whereas values between 0 and 1 indicate less mixing than expected.


targets::tar_read(plotdata_sexorientation_mixing_matrix) |>
  dplyr::filter(ego_level != "Something Else", alter_level != "Something Else") |> 
  plot_matrix_mixing() +
  scale_fill_mpxnyc_gradient("Spatial\nmixing\ncoefficient", labels = scales::label_percent(), breaks = c(-0.5, 0, 0.5, 1), limits = c(-0.5,  1.2)) +
  scale_color_mpxnyc_gradient() +
  ggplot2::scale_alpha_discrete(guide = "none") +
  theme_mpxnyc_mixing() 

```
